entries.impact: The C2J URI label name of a member whose label the converter renamed to the member name. The wire is unchanged; only the original label name is marker-only.

C2J metadata properties with no standard trait (for example globalEndpoint, checksumFormat, resultWrapped, or a targetPrefix that cannot be the service shape name) are only available from this marker, which holds just those properties.
The declared order and duplicates of operation errors. Operation errors are also emitted, so only the order and duplicates are marker-only.
@paginated has one input_token; a paginator with several is not converted. The operation gets no @paginated trait, so no paginator is generated from standard traits.
The limit_key is not a top-level input member that targets an integral shape, so @paginated has no pageSize.
@paginated has no more_results member. Pagination ends when the output token is absent, not when the more_results member is false.
@paginated has one output_token; a paginator with several is not converted. The operation gets no @paginated trait, so no paginator is generated from standard traits.
The declaration order of required members. @required is also emitted, so only the order is marker-only.
Smithy waiters bound waiting by maxWaitTime, not by attempt count. A waiter generated from standard traits does not get the C2J maxAttempts.
